components.title: Routes comparison

components.text: The two main driving routes to Madikeri are the Mysuruuru–Hunsur–Kushalnagar route and the Hassan–Kushalnagar route. The Mysuru route is the most commonly recommended and generally the most convenient for first-time travelers while the Hassan route is usually a good alternative when you want to avoid the Mysuru corridor.[2][4][11]
